value.rationale: The fan is a natural graph family with an open-boundary effect not captured by wheel formulas: its entire periodic-state set is identified with morphological openings satisfying an exact volume inversion, and all primitive two-cycles have a flipping hub. A finite transfer gives exact counts at arbitrary graph size and detects the exceptional length \(n=4\) where oscillations disappear. This is a natural complete infinite-family classification with a distinct boundary phenomenon, rather than an isolated finite datum or a change in notation.
